items.item_text: Bachelors in Administrative Assistant, Medical Administrative Assistant, Business, Office Administration, Health Science or related field OR a combination of education and/or equivalent administrative support experience may be considered (two years of related experience will be credited for each one year of education)
Minimum of four (4) years experience in executive support and project management
Experience in an acute care hospital or healthcare facility
Provides and updates information on behalf of the Vice President to requesting departments/agencies/companies as appropriate.

Schedules/arranges meetings and appointments for the Vice President to include sending notices, reminders , changes, cancellations and/or confirming scheduled appointments. Ensures accommodations are adequate; schedules and confirms food service, conference rooms, and equipment when need.

Reminds the Vice President daily of calendar appointments for that day to include location, time, and meeting subject matter, in addition to ensuring the they have all materials needed for said meetings.
Takes, prepares and distributes minutes for various meetings as directed/requested by the Vice President.

Creates and maintains various reports, and works on special projects as requested by the Vice President. Proofreads, edits and prioritize documents to include highly technical and/or procedure drafts in order to ensure accuracy, neatness, precise use of grammar, punctuation and data.
Creates and maintains filing systems to include copies of all pertinent information to maintain accurate, precise and easily accessible records and other tasks
